newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura Sec Oct-Dec current profit up 16.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Nomura Sec Oct-Dec current profit up 16.2 pct.

text.p: Nomura Securities Co Ltd said on Thursday it posted a parent current profit of 33.82 billion yen in the three months to December 31, 1996, up 16.2 percent from the same period a year earlier.
Nomura's operating revenue for the October-December quarter stood at 183.14 billion yen, while operating profit totalled 34.03 billion yen, a company executive told reporters.

Japanese financial authorities have allowed Nomura to treat the money it used to back up its troubled financial affiliate as a loss, which should trim the company's corporate tax payment by 35 billion yen for this fiscal year, he said.
This should help Nomura's business performance for the year ending on March 31, 1997, he added.
